name: Autistica
description: A UK autism research and campaigning charity that funds and shares research, develops resources and works on policy and public understanding.
intended_use: Find autism research, research participation opportunities, evidence-informed projects and UK policy work.
audience_or_context: Autistic people, families, researchers, professionals and people looking for UK autism research and policy information.
limitations: Autistica states that it is not a support service and cannot provide individual medical or crisis support.
Research summaries and resources should still be read with their study-specific limitations and provenance.
cost_or_access_notes: Public information and many resources are available online; participation, events or projects may have separate conditions.
conflicts_of_interest: The charity funds, develops and promotes some of the research and resources it describes and fundraises for its work.

provenance.method: Official organisation, research and contact information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, scope and access without converting organisational authority into general evidential authority.
